Actions.Title: Read prompt
Actions.Description: Read an active versioned prompt by its registered purpose.

Actions.Title: Save prompt draft
Actions.Description: Save a new immutable prompt draft. Existing generations and active prompts keep their current versions.

Actions.Title: Publish prompt revision
Actions.Description: Select an existing prompt revision for future work. Select an earlier revision to roll back.

Actions.Title: List prompt purposes
Actions.Description: List registered prompt purposes and their active revision history.

Actions.Title: Retry uncertain generation
Actions.Description: Explicitly retry the retained request only after checking ComfyUI history. Use the request identity shown in the action result or log.

Actions.Title: Inspect image requests
Actions.Description: Read saved request identities, states and execution errors.
